title: Branch CI runs only what the diff can affect; journeys, retrieval eval and scale tests by area

story.as_a: session waiting on its branch's CI before merge
story.i_want_to: have CI run the tests my diff can affect, and the journey, retrieval-eval and scale suites only when my diff touches their area
story.so_that: a branch's CI answers in under five minutes while master still runs everything

rationale: Every branch push runs the whole suite plus the journeys (.github/workflows/ci.yml:517-526), the retrieval eval (ci.yml:553) and the scale tests (ci.yml:972-987). Branch CI runs on 2026-11-20/21 took 5 to 14 minutes wall clock (gh run list). Once this epic's trunk verifier and red-master hunt are live (README, Merge order), the full run on each master tip is the net: a test a branch skipped and broke turns master red and is reverted. chg's adapter already selects affected tests from the module graph and a test reference cache (chg/adapters/elixir/lib/mix/tasks/chg.affected.ex:3-23), with always_all as the fail-closed escape (.chg/adapter.toml:396-420). #985 asks to measure stale-manifest selection against xref selection: this story takes chg's (xref plus references), because `mix test --stale` needs the base's manifest restored from a shared cache, which ci.yml stopped sharing on purpose (ci.yml:93-114), and chg's shadow log on minis already pairs its selection against the full gate (41 pushes, 0 misses, 2026-11-20).

acceptance_criteria.description: .github/scripts/suite-areas.sh <base> <head> prints `retrieval` when base...head changes a path in its retrieval list, `scale` when it changes a path in its scale list, and both when the base is unreadable or a changed path matches .chg/adapter.toml's always_all list.

areas-output.sh writes changes-job outputs retrieval and scale from suite-areas.sh for a branch push (base = merge base with origin/master, as for server today), and true for both on a master push, a schedule and a manual run.

The Retrieval Eval job's if becomes `needs.changes.outputs.server == 'true' && needs.changes.outputs.retrieval == 'true'`, and the Scale Tests job's adds `needs.changes.outputs.scale == 'true'` to its existing condition, so each is skipped (which a required check accepts) on a branch that does not touch its area.

On a push to any branch but master, the Test job runs .github/scripts/select-tests.sh, which runs `chg adapter exec snapshot` and then `chg adapter exec affected --base <merge base with origin/master>` and writes the selection JSON to $RUNNER_TEMP/selection.json.

For a selection of mode subset, `Run tests` runs `mix test --warnings-as-errors` on the selected files outside test/e2e, and `Run e2e journey tests` runs `mix test --only e2e --warnings-as-errors` on the selected files under test/e2e; an empty list prints `no test affected by this diff` (or `no journey test affected by this diff`) and passes.

A selection of mode all, a chg exit other than 0, JSON that does not parse, or a selection that runs past 10 minutes runs the whole suite and all journeys, after `::warning::affected selection unavailable (<reason>); running the whole suite`.
On a master push, a schedule and a manual run, the Test job runs `mix test --warnings-as-errors` and `mix test --only e2e --warnings-as-errors` with no selection step, exactly as before.
select-tests.sh appends to $GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY the selection mode, chg's reason and the selected files, so a reviewer can see what a green branch run did not test.

technical_notes: Selection: chg.affected prints {"mode":"subset","reason","tests"} or {"mode":"all","reason"} (chg.affected.ex:17-23); `chg adapter exec affected` applies always_all first (:22-23). The test reference cache is _build/chg/test_refs.etf (chg/adapters/elixir/lib/chg_adapter/refs.ex:17, chg_adapter.ex:10), written by mix chg.snapshot (chg.snapshot.ex:3-25), which refuses a project compiling with the cwd check on. A cache recorded at HEAD is valid input: ChgAdapter.Select also selects test files changed since the snapshot (select.ex:5-12).

The persistent runner tree keeps _build between jobs (ci.yml:93-114), so the snapshot step is incremental. When Epic 52's US-52.58 lands, its warm step (chg snapshot fetch + chg ws hydrate) runs before this one and the snapshot step finds work none; neither story needs the other.

Base: the merge base with origin/master, the base areas-output.sh already uses for a branch push (.github/scripts/areas-output.sh:21-25). An epic story's push therefore selects over the whole epic, which is wider, never narrower.

Default retrieval list: lib/loopctl/knowledge/**, priv/retrieval_eval/**, lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.retrieval.eval.ex, AGENTS.md (the job also runs mix usage_rules.sync --check, ci.yml:674-675), docs/runbooks/retrieval_eval.md. Default scale list: lib/loopctl/knowledge/**, lib/loopctl/memory/**, lib/loopctl/workers/revoke_expired_dispatches*.ex, lib/mix/tasks/loopctl.seed_scale.ex, and the test files the Scale Tests job runs (ci.yml:1111-1150). Both are owner-tunable.

Guards to keep green: test/loopctl/ci_warnings_as_errors_test.exs:49-62 asserts the exact `Run tests` and `Run e2e journey tests` commands; it changes to assert that every mix test invocation in the Test job and in select-tests.sh carries --warnings-as-errors. factory_ci_workflows_test.exs:296-308 requires each gated job's if to start with the server clause, which AC-53.4.3 keeps.

Accepted loss, stated: a subset run does not load every test file, so the duplicate-module load warning (#824, ci.yml:508-516) is caught only by master's full run, where the red-master hunt reverts it.

Required checks are unchanged (Lint, Test, Security, Dialyzer, Retrieval Eval, Pgbouncer e2e (US-27.13), Scale Tests (US-27.1), MCP Server Gate; gh api .../protection/required_status_checks, 2026-11-20); a job skipped by its if reports skipped, which they accept (ci.yml:138-143).
docs/runbooks/chg-flow.md gains a `Branch CI` section: what a branch run skips, the area lists, how to force the whole suite (touch a path in always_all, or gh workflow run CI --ref <branch>).
non_goals: Coverage-based selection from refs/chg/cover records (chg/docs/verify.md:19-22): needs the trunk verifier to run the suite itself; an owner question.
Selecting inside lint, dialyzer, security or pgbouncer-e2e: they stay whole.

failure_modes.partition: AC-53.4.6: a chg that cannot run or answer makes the job run the whole suite, so an outage costs time, never coverage.
failure_modes.state: AC-53.4.4: the selection lives in the job's own $RUNNER_TEMP and the reference cache in the job tree's _build/chg; nothing is shared between jobs or read from another run.
failure_modes.retry: AC-53.4.7: a re-run of a branch run selects again from the same base and head and runs the same files; master runs are untouched.
failure_modes.slow: AC-53.4.6: selection is capped at 10 minutes, after which the job runs the whole suite instead of waiting.
failure_modes.reach: AC-53.4.2: the area decision is made in the changes job from the event and the diff, on whichever slot takes it.

definition_of_done: Ten branch pushes after the merge: the CI run median wall clock (gh run list --workflow ci.yml --event push, excluding master) is under 5 minutes, and the PR body records it beside the median of the ten branch runs before.
One of those pushes touches only lib/loopctl/tenants.ex and shows Retrieval Eval and Scale Tests skipped and a subset in the Test summary.
The PR merges only after the red-master hunt is live on master (README, Merge order); it may be built before that.
No master run in the following week is red on a test a green branch run skipped without the red-master hunt reverting it.
defaults: PR CI target: median under 5 minutes (owner may change).
Selection timeout 10 minutes, then the whole suite.
Retrieval and scale path lists as in technical_notes (owner may change).
Selection by chg's module graph and reference cache, not mix test --stale.
